high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the movie "Bison Kaalamaadan" directed by Mari Selvaraj. The poster features three men dressed in maroon suits with red ties, each adorned with a green and white ribbon on their left lapel, indicating some form of recognition or achievement. They are holding a trophy that resembles an Arjuna Award, which is a prestigious sports award in India. The men appear to be celebrating, as they are smiling and laughing together. The man in the center has his arm around the other two, suggesting camaraderie and shared success.
